The '''Fleet of the Glorious Defender Queen''' was a [[Hapan]] [[Fleet/Legends|warfleet]] that saw action during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]].

==History==
The Fleet of the Glorious Defender Queen was led by [[Dukat]] [[Aleson Gray]], aboard the [[Hapan Battle Dragon]] ''[[Kendall]]''. During the Dark Nest Crisis in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]], the fleet fought at the [[Battle of Qoribu]] on behalf of the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], who were being attacked by the forces of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. The Fleet of the Glorious Defender Queen was originally intended to keep the peace by acting as a deterrent to [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] aggression, but ultimately was drawn into the engagement when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] arrived in the [[Gyuel system]] aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and prompted a conflict of interest between the Chiss and the Hapans.
